subject: Next steps: PoV plan & acceptance criteria for Lorelei Analytics
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@lorelei.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@lorelei.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today — confirmation of pain & goals

Vivek / team,

Thanks for the call this morning — appreciated the clear walkthrough of Redwood's runtime and how you approach predictable latency for inference. Quick recap from our side to make sure we're aligned before we sketch a short PoV plan.

Top pain points we discussed:
- High per-token inference cost with our current setup; costs spike on peak queries.
- Unreliable tail latency for batched workloads during business hours (sporadic 500–700ms tails).
- Lack of visibility into token-level cost per endpoint; hard to optimize prompt engineering.

Primary goals for a short-term PoV (4 weeks):
1) Reduce average per-token cost by 20% on our most frequent prompt set.
2) Improve p95 latency for 1–2 high-throughput endpoints to <300ms.
3) Validate Redwood's batching + caching benefits with our prompt suite and measure quality regression (BLEU-style / human spot-check).

Constraints / notes:
- We need the PoV to run within our existing VPC (private deployment) or a dedicated sandbox in your hosted environment — security team will sign off on either.
- Procurement wants an initial scope doc before legal kicks off contract redlines.

Next asks from us to Redwood:
- A one-page PoV scope (owners, timeline, success metrics, access steps).
- A list of required credentials and network configuration for the VPC flow (or a hosted onboarding checklist).
- A short proposal for who from Redwood will be our technical POC and owner for day-to-day coordination.

Attaching the security questionnaire we mentioned (PDF). Procurement will fill and return by Friday.

Jordan
VP Engineering, Lorelei Analytics
[jordan.ellis@lorelei.ai]

Attachment: lorelei-security-questionnaire.pdf (2 pages)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@lorelei.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — confirmation of pain & goals

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming receipt of the questionnaire. We've sketched a concise PoV plan below to give procurement and your engineering team something concrete to review.

Proposed PoV (3 weeks exec + 1 week buffer) — high level:
- Scope: Evaluate 2 production-critical endpoints (search-summarize and FAQ-answer) with your existing prompt suite (~1.2M tokens/month current baseline).
- Success metrics: cost reduction >= 20% (tokens/op economics), p95 latency < 300ms for targeted endpoints, model output quality delta within agreed thresholds (we'll run a 200-sample eval set + 10 manual spot checks).
- Owners: Vivek Kulkarni (Sales Eng, Redwood) — program owner; Priyom Das (Solutions Eng, Redwood) — technical lead; Jordan Ellis (Engineering, Lorelei) — customer lead.
- Timeline:
  * Week 0 (this week): NDA/procurement review + access provisioning; security questionnaire returned.
  * Week 1: Baseline collection — run against current infra to collect token and latency distributions.
  * Week 2: Redwood integration — deploy compatible model variant, enable batching + KV prefix caching, apply recommended quantization profile to a test cluster.
  * Week 3: Evaluate performance & quality on the 200-sample prompt set; iterate on batching params.
  * Week 4: Wrap & recommendations; handoff an ops playbook for scale.
- Prompt/eval plan: We'll take your canonical prompt set (please confirm attachment with examples) and build a 200-sample eval harness; outputs will be scored programmatically and 10 examples flagged for human review.
- Access/setup steps (minimal):
  1) Provide read-only S3 bucket with sample logs or a small dump (or we can use live endpoints if you prefer).
  2) Service account with scoped access for baseline collection (we only require tokenized logs and latency metrics).
  3) For private deployment: CIDR ranges + peering details (we can also propose a hosted-dedicated sandbox to speed timeline).

Attachments we'll share immediately: redwood-pov-charter-template.pdf (one-pager PoV scope), SSO & onboarding checklist (link).

If that aligns, Priyom and Stephanie will send a short onboarding checklist and a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff (tech sync).

Best —
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-pov-charter-template.pdf (1 page)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: PoV owners + creds needed

Vivek / Steph — quick internal note so we don't miss any ops items.
- I'll own the integration and baseline collection (Week 1–2).
- Stephanie — can you pick up quantization/cluster config and cost analysis (Week 2–3)?
- Need from Lorelei: test S3 access OR ephemeral API key for baseline scraping; network peering contact; procurement contact for non-prod environment (so we can provision a dedicated sandbox if needed).

I'll draft the kickoff agenda and drop it in the shared Drive link Vivek referenced.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@lorelei.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lorelei.ai
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — confirmation of pain & goals

Vivek — procurement looped in (procurement@lorelei.ai). We reviewed the PoV plan internally and agree to the scope and timeline; we can target a Week 0 kickoff next Tuesday (May 12) if Redwood can provide the checklist and the one-pager.

A couple of notes from security/procurement:
- We'll complete and return the security questionnaire by EOD Monday.
- On the deployment model: preferred path is a lightweight hosted-dedicated sandbox to avoid heavy VPC work up front; procurement will still need standard SOC2-related artifacts (if you can surface them).
- Procurement contact is Mira Chen (mira.chen@lorelei.ai) — she'll handle the initial SOW/redline.

I'll attach the partially-filled questionnaire; procurement will add Mira to the thread.

Jordan

Jordan / Mira — great to hear. Confirming Redwood deliverables before the tech sync on Tue May 12 (30 min):
- Deliverables (today / EOD Monday): PoV one-pager (charter), onboarding checklist, SOC2 summary link, sample SOW template.
- Tech sync agenda (30 min): intros, baseline data requirements, access plan (hosted sandbox vs VPC), immediate blockers, calendar for Week 1 baseline run.
- Meeting: Tue May 12, 10:00am PT — Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (calendar invite to follow).

Action items assigned:
- Vivek: send PoV charter + SOW template (EOD).
- Priyom: send onboarding checklist + list of minimal credentials (EOD).

- Lorelei (Jordan / Mira): return completed security questionnaire; confirm if hosted sandbox is acceptable.

Looking forward — we'll keep this lightweight and data-driven.

Best,
Vivek
